title: Use explicit source count fields
decision: SG-0007 should replace ambiguous generic source_count fields or messages with explicit source count labels, such as provenance_source_count and retained_regulatory_source_count. document_count remains separate.
context: After deciding that many original source records become non-browseable provenance stubs while regulatory sources remain retained app inputs, a bare source_count in workspace.json or import output could imply retained source files.
rationale: Explicit counts make the cleaned workspace easier to understand and reduce the chance that UI, service responses, or validation reports misrepresent provenance stubs as retained source files.
alternatives_considered: Keep the existing generic source_count field
Remove all source counts from import summaries
Count only retained regulatory sources and discard provenance counts
consequences: workspace.json import_summary should keep document_count but avoid a bare source_count
The import summary should distinguish provenance-only source records from retained regulatory sources
Importer console output should use the same explicit labels
SG-0013 service responses should not expose a generic source_count that blurs retained and provenance-only sources
